name: Safie Inc.
summary: Safie Inc. develops and operates a cloud-based video recording platform under the Safie brand in Japan. The company provides cloud security cameras, such as Safie One, VIVOTEK FD9166-HN (SF), AXIS M5074PTZ, VIVOTEK FD9186-H(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LAUX(SF), i-PRO WV-U1532LA(SF), Safie GO 360, Safie GO PTZ Plus, Safie GO PTZ, Safie GO 180, AXIS P1468-XLE, Orient Brain RC-360BL, Safie PT CAM, VIVOTEK FD9383-HV(2.8mm)(SF), Safie Pocket2 Plus, and Safie Pocket2. Its products are used in various industries, including retail, food service, construction, logistics, manufacturing, infrastructure, public services, and healthcare. Safie Inc. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
